findings.description: Image 00 (t=4.25s, settled Act 1 - ProtoType): Strong protagonist dominance, crisp blue accent border, well-balanced 3 corner sub cards, and neat 4/4 dock grid. Minor: the top-left dock thumbnail is nearly solid black and blurs into the dock plate at 350px width, almost reading as an empty slot.

Image 01 (t=5.50s, mid-transition Act 1->2): Causal hand-off (Telecaster B-Boy expands from top-left while ProtoType recedes to top-right without center pileup). Issues: (1) Both main cards sit in the upper half, leaving ~35% empty dead space across the lower canvas; (2) Blue accent border transferred slightly early while the incoming card is still off-center to upper-left; (3) Dock drops to 1/4 visible (only BL thumb) with faint muddy silhouettes occluded behind the plate; (4) Faint dark lossy-WebP inter-frame ghost rectangles remain in the vacated bottom-left/top-right dark margins.

Image 02 (t=6.00s, settled Act 2 - Telecaster B-Boy): Very clean settled composition—strong visual hierarchy, crisp blue border, high readability at 350px, and neat 4/4 dock. Minor: bottom-left dark macOS UI sub card is very dark/low-contrast.
Image 03 (t=6.50s, settled Act 2): Clean playback continuity (combo/score/character motion and dock thumbnail content advance smoothly); no stretching, freezing, or layout drift.

Image 04 (t=10.00s, early/mid-transition Act 2->3): Clean causal hand-off with incoming AE timeline rising behind outgoing Telecaster (which still holds blue border/z-order). Dock shows only 2/4 diagonal thumbs (TL, BR) leaving half the tray blank; a small sliver of the departing anime-girl card peeks out between protagonist's bottom-right edge and dock; moderate dead space in bottom-left corner and faint WebP ghosting in top-right dark margin.

Image 05 (t=10.75s, late transition Act 2->3): Protagonist z-order and blue accent border transfer cleanly to AE timeline while Telecaster settles neatly to top-right. Critical dock regression: 0/4 thumbnails are visible above the dock plate—the entire dock turns into a blank slate box with ghostly occluded rectangles faintly visible underneath and a 2-3px grey border sliver poking out above the plate's top-left edge. Because all 4 cards re-slot/arrive simultaneously and stay behind the plate until within ~5px, they appear wrongly disappeared and will abruptly pop in across 1 frame at 8fps. Faint WebP ghosting also visible at far left.

Image 06 (t=11.25s, settled Act 3 - AE timeline): Strong settled hierarchy, crisp blue border, clean 3 corner sub cards, and all 4/4 dock thumbnails neatly aligned after popping back in. Minor: both top-row dock thumbnails (TL ProtoType, TR dark UI) are very dark and lose legibility against the dark plate at 350px width.

Image 07 (t=15.75s, mid-transition Act 3->4): Good causal protagonist hand-off (pointing anime girl rises from top-left behind outgoing AE card). Dock keeps 2/4 top-row thumbnails parked (bottom row empty). The incoming yellow Telecaster card (traveling from TR toward dock) is wedged between the outgoing protagonist's right edge and the dock plate's top-left corner while still larger than thumbnail size, clipping behind the plate edge and making the lower-right feel pinched while far bottom-left is empty.

Image 08 (t=16.25s, late transition Act 3->4): Clean protagonist z-order/accent hand-off to high-contrast anime girl MV (excellent 350px readability). Dock occlusion defect: bottom row remains 0/2 visible (2/4 total) with a cyan sliver peeking out from behind the dock plate's left edge and a faint ghost behind the plate—reads as a clipping/disappearance bug rather than intentional depth. Top-left sub card is also a nearly flat grey frame that looks slightly empty.

Image 09 (t=21.25s, late Act 4 / transition onset): Protagonist dominates clearly with crisp blue border. Two defects: (1) Top-left corner sub card is nearly solid black/invisible with insufficient rim contrast, making the top-left corner look missing; (2) Dock shows 3/4 (BR empty) while the departing cyan anime-girl card is awkwardly cut off behind the left edge of the dock plate, sandwiched between protagonist and dock.

Image 10 (t=21.75s, mid-transition Act 4->5): Strong causal entry vector as blue/white grid card grows from bottom-left behind outgoing anime girl MV (retaining blue border). Issues: (1) Entire top-left quadrant (~25% of frame) is empty dark dead space while the incoming TL sub card is hidden in transit; (2) Cyan anime-girl card is pinched to a tiny sliver peeking below the seam between both large cards; (3) Dock down to 2/4 (TR, BL) with faint WebP ghosting in upper dark margins.

Image 11 (t=22.25s, post-boundary Act 5): Protagonist (blue/white grid '夜 night') has cleanly claimed center and blue accent border with excellent 350px legibility, and all 3 corner sub cards are settled (though TL ProtoType is quite dark). Major dock lag/clipping defect: even 0.25s past the 22.0s act boundary, only 2/4 dock thumbnails are visible (TL and BR remain empty) while a ~4px horizontal sliver of FoldLayers pokes out above the dock plate's top-left edge.

verdict.summary: Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES. Settled acts (00, 02, 03, 06) and protagonist-to-protagonist hand-offs have strong hierarchy, clear causality, clean blue accent tracking, no stretched/frozen frames, and solid ~350px readability. However, revision 5's strict ~5px dock settle gate causes dock thumbnails to vanish completely (0/4 in Frame 05) or lag past act boundaries (2/4 in Frame 11) with awkward 3-6px slivers peeking behind the plate edges (Frames 05, 08, 09, 11)—reading as broken pop-in/clipping rather than intentional depth. Top 3 fixes by impact: (1) Fix dock occlusion & pop-in: keep re-slotting cards above the plate so the dock never empties to 0/4 (Frame 05), ease/expand the settle hand-off (or cross-fade/raise z-order once near thumbnail size) and finish dock travel before the act boundary so all 4 thumbs settle cleanly without peeking slivers (Frames 05, 08, 09, 11); (2) Reduce mid-transition dead space & tune Act 1->2 border timing: keep incoming/outgoing cards better balanced vertically in Frame 01 (delaying blue border transfer slightly until closer to center) and reveal the incoming top-left sub card earlier in Frame 10 to fill the empty top-left quadrant; (3) Lift dark card visibility & clean WebP ghosting: strengthen subtle rim brightness and minimum dark floor/clip offsets for near-black dock thumbs (00 TL, 06 TL/TR, 08-11 TR) and dark sub cards (09 TL, 02-03 BL) for 350px legibility, and reduce lossy WebP delta-frame ghost blocks on the dark canvas during transitions.
